label: win (2-seed evidence)
note: Frontier +8/+14 (p=0.057 / 0.0026; Fisher 0.0015); best graded regret (1.98) and best unseen row (177/200); same direction on every exam at both seeds.
result: Before, the value network predicted an internal plan-step count. Now it predicts the real number of robot moves. On new boards it scored 173 vs 172 at one training run, and 177 vs 170 at the other. Better at both. That 177 is the best score of any single TRAINING change (the v07 SEARCH change scores higher). It was also better on the hard exam in both runs. The combined chance of luck is about 1 in 700. And it wasted the fewest moves of the whole program on the standard exam.
conclusion: Adopted. Train on the number you are graded on.
